# The node relay's wire format (`GET /node`, WebSocket subprotocols
# `stencil-relay.v1` and `stencil-relay.v2`) as test vectors, read by both
# implementations' tests: stencil-net's client
# (crates/net/src/relay/proto.rs) and this service
# (node_frames_test.go). Change the format here first; both suites then fail
# until they agree with it.
#
# Each binary WebSocket message holds frames back to back: a type byte, the
# body's length as a little-endian u16, the body. Integers are little-endian.
#
# One vector a line, five fields separated by " | ":
#   name | use | message hex | what it reads as | description
# use: "both" (encoding the frames gives the message bytes exactly, and
# reading the bytes gives the frames), "read" (reading only: what a reader
# must accept or refuse), "proof" (no message: a registration signature).
# What it reads as: the frames in order, separated by "; ", each
# "<kind> <field>=<value> ...", then optionally the error the reader stops
# with: "!truncated" (a header or body runs past the message) or
# "!body=<type byte, hex>" (a body too short for its type, or malformed).
# Values: bytes as hex ("-": none), unsigned integers in decimal, socket
# addresses as 203.0.113.9:4433 or [2001:db8::1]:443.
#
# Frame kinds and their type bytes: auth 01 (node, sig), connect 02 (peer),
# send 03 (route, datagram), ping 04 (n), release 05 (route), send-to 06
# (peer, datagram; v2 links only, a v1 reader skips it), challenge 81
# (nonce), welcome 82 (observed), route 83 (peer, route, observed), no-peer
# 84 (peer), recv 85 (route, datagram), pong 86 (n), gone 87 (route),
# closing 88 (reason, retry_ms). Reasons: 1 replaced, 2 restarting,
# 3 limited, 4 protocol, 5 refused.
auth | both | 016000070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070709090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909 | auth node=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 sig=09090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909090909 | node → relay: its id and its signature over the challenge
connect | both | 0220000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | connect peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | node → relay: a route to peer, please
send | both | 03080003000000deadbeef | send route=3 datagram=deadbeef | node → relay: a datagram for route 3's peer
send-empty | both | 03040003000000 | send route=3 datagram=- | node → relay: an empty datagram is a datagram
send-to | both | 0624000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707deadbeef | send-to peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 datagram=deadbeef | node → relay (v2 links): a datagram for peer, over the route the node's connect asked for, before the route's answer arrives
send-to-empty | both | 0620000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | send-to peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 datagram=- | node → relay (v2 links): an empty datagram is a datagram
connect-send-to | both | 02200007070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070624000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707deadbeef | connect peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707; send-to peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 datagram=deadbeef | node → relay (v2 links): a dial's first message, the route's request and the datagram behind it
ping | both | 040800ffffffffffffffff | ping n=18446744073709551615 | node → relay: is the link alive?
release | both | 05040004000000 | release route=4 | node → relay: the node no longer needs route 4
challenge | both | 8120000101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101 | challenge nonce=0101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101 | relay → node: prove your id over this nonce
welcome-v4 | both | 82070004cb0071095111 | welcome observed=203.0.113.9:4433 | relay → node: registered; its address as the relay sees it (family 4, address, port LE)
welcome-v6 | both | 8213000620010db8000000000000000000000001bb01 | welcome observed=[2001:db8::1]:443 | relay → node: registered, seen over IPv6 (family 6)
welcome-port-0 | both | 82070004c63364070000 | welcome observed=198.51.100.7:0 | relay → node: behind a TLS terminator the relay knows no port
route | both | 8337000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707ffffffff0620010db8000000000000000000000001bb01 | route peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 route=4294967295 observed=[2001:db8::1]:443 | relay → node: route 4294967295 leads to peer, seen at that address
no-peer | both | 8420000707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | no-peer peer=0707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | relay → node: peer has no link to this relay
recv | both | 850600050000000102 | recv route=5 datagram=0102 | relay → node: a datagram from route 5's peer
pong | both | 8608000100000000000000 | pong n=1 | relay → node: the answer to ping 1
gone | both | 87040006000000 | gone route=6 | relay → node: route 6 ended
closing-replaced | both | 8805000130750000 | closing reason=1 retry_ms=30000 | relay → node: a newer link registered the node; come back in 30 s
closing-restarting | both | 88050002dc050000 | closing reason=2 retry_ms=1500 | relay → node: the relay is restarting; come back in 1.5 s
closing-limited | both | 8805000360ea0000 | closing reason=3 retry_ms=60000 | relay → node: over the network's limits
closing-protocol | both | 8805000400000000 | closing reason=4 retry_ms=0 | relay → node: the node broke the protocol or failed its proof
closing-unknown | both | 880500c800000000 | closing reason=200 retry_ms=0 | relay → node: a reason a later version added
batch | both | 860800020000000000000085050005000000aa87040006000000 | pong n=2; recv route=5 datagram=aa; gone route=6 | several frames back to back in one message
read-unknown-skipped | read | 7f0200aabb0408000500000000000000 | ping n=5 | a frame type the reader does not know is skipped
read-longer-body | read | 0409000500000000000000ff | ping n=5 | a body longer than its type needs (a later version's additions) is read
read-truncated-header | read | 04080001000000000000000220 | ping n=1 !truncated | a frame header cut short ends the message
read-truncated-body | read | 02200007070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | !truncated | a body shorter than its length field ends the message
read-short-body | read | 021f00070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070408000100000000000000 | !body=02 | a body too short for its type is an error, and nothing after it is read
read-bad-family | read | 82070005010203040000 | !body=82 | an address family other than 4 or 6 is an error
read-short-send-to | read | 061f0007070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707070707 | !body=06 | a send-to body shorter than its peer is an error
proof | proof | - | proof seed=2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a node=197f6b23e16c8532c6abc838facd5ea789be0c76b2920334039bfa8b3d368d61 nonce=0505050505050505050505050505050505050505050505050505050505050505 sig=492ceb9db20d52b93fb799e183c3ddc4872e59ecc5bb67e59a93371e1694fd98d37a6a9eb465f77d264cc9206e173d4fed084095c41068f5346a2feaa8a5c403 | the Ed25519 node of seed, and its Auth signature over "stencil-relay v1 challenge" || nonce
